Silver Touch Hospitals have many patients who are surprised to discover that not all surgery must be accompanied by lengthy hospitalisation or sophisticated recovery. If that is the reason you are afraid to meet with general surgeons, let us quell your fears.

Not all surgeries are major, and our surgeons often perform minor procedures to offer patients the necessary relief from pain, prevent complications, and enhance daily functioning. Anyone in need of top-notch surgical expertise should consider consulting a reputable general surgeon in Ahmedabad to tackle such problems safely and effectively. You can find some of the finest general surgeons at Silver Touch Hospitals.

What Are Minor Surgical Procedures?

Minor surgeries are those with limited risks that may be performed under local anaesthesia and that typically permit the patient to go home on the same day. Although less taxing than major operations, they are nonetheless performed with the same care and safety precautions by skilled surgeons.

Common Minor Surgeries Provided at Silver Touch Hospitals

1. Abscess Drainage

An abscess is a pocket of pus that causes pain, swelling, and sometimes fever. Quick surgical drainage relieves symptoms and prevents the infection from spreading.

2. Cyst Removal

Sebaceous or skin cysts are common and often harmless, but can become infected or bothersome. Removing them surgically provides permanent relief.

3. Biopsies

A biopsy consists of taking a small tissue sample for analysis. It’s a simple procedure that is instrumental in the early diagnosis of conditions.

4. Circumcision

This minor urology operation is usually carried out for medical purposes, such as repeated infections or phimosis.

5. Ingrown Toenail and Nail Bed Surgery

Severe nail infections or painful ingrown nails can be addressed in a quick and easy surgical procedure, relieving pain and recurrence.

So, these are some of the minor surgeries our skilled general surgeons perform. However, if you need information regarding any specific procedure, do not hesitate to visit your nearest branch of Silver Touch Hospitals.

Why Minor Procedures Are Important

Neglecting conditions that need such minor procedures can cause more severe complications in the long run. An early appointment with the surgeon ensures faster recovery and improved long-term health results.

Expert Treatment at Silver Touch Hospitals

Our staff of professionals conducts a full variety of minor procedures with an emphasis on the comfort and safety of the patient. State-of-the-art facilities, sterile methods, and post-operative instructions guarantee easy recovery for all patients.

If you are looking for skilled treatment from a general surgeon in Ahmedabad, Silver Touch Hospitals is dedicated to delivering the best levels of care.
